item.title: Comment on Claims about fires? by Dino Sauron
item.description:
One easy thing that could be done to make a marginal improvement is condemning palm trees as a fire hazard, removing them and prohibit the further use.

This may sound silly, but… king palms grow to 50+ feet tall. As they grow the fronds die and dry out, but remain attached to the palm stalk - as a kind of dry sheath. In fires they go up like torches - with high winds the burning fronds can can sail up to a mile from their source. These fronds are 2x3 feet wide and slightly longer, weighing up to 10 pounds so they are a substantial fire threat - calling them embers is huge understatement.

item.title: Comment on Claims about fires? by Dino Sauron
item.description:
The controlled burns would not be done in densely settled areas. They would be done on chaparral covered hills and valleys in the vicinity of developments at times of year with low wind and higher humidity. The land immediately adjacent to homes is cleared / thinned out manually.

Part of the problem has been that dense chaparral grows right up to property lines - which are close to structures. In most cases property owners are prohibited from clearing such vegetation that is not on their property.
